introduction: The sandbox gateway lets an embedder create and use sandboxes on another host: a `gateway.Dial` client in the sandbox module implements `sandbox.Provider` over a bearer-authenticated gRPC connection, and the nested `sandbox/gatewayd` module (with its `agentkit-gateway` command) holds one backend provider, owns every sandbox it creates per token, and relays the Agent protocol to each sandbox so it behaves exactly like a locally created one.

glossary.GitRepo slot: Spec 17's per-sandbox rule that a `GitRepo` sync must be the first Sync and precede Tools; the gateway keeps it itself because relayed RPCs bypass the backend wrapper.
glossary.backend: The single `sandbox.Provider` a gateway holds (`local` in offline tests, `podman` in the command).
glossary.gateway: The `Gateway` gRPC service in `gateway.proto` plus the Agent relay, served by `gatewayd.Server` on a remote host.
glossary.gateway client: Package `sandbox/gateway` in the sandbox module: `Dial`, `Provider` and the sandboxes it returns.
glossary.gatewayd: The nested module `github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go/sandbox/gatewayd` holding the server library and the `agentkit-gateway` command.
glossary.network ceiling: `gatewayd.Config.NetworkModes`: the network modes the gateway lets clients request, intersected with the backend's modes.
glossary.owner: The SHA-256 of the bearer token that created a sandbox; the only identity the server keeps. Logs show its first 8 hex characters (the fingerprint).
glossary.refusal: The typed `Refusal` message (kind UNSUPPORTED, NO_AGENT, NO_PUBLISHED_IMAGE, PROTOCOL, CAPACITY or REFUSED) a Create or SyncGit response carries instead of a gRPC error.
glossary.relay: The typed `Agent` service implementation in gatewayd that forwards Hello, Tools, Call, SyncTar, ExportTar and Rsync to the backend sandbox named by `agentkit-sandbox-id`.
glossary.sandbox_unavailable: The error class of `sandbox.ErrUnavailable`: the sandbox met a transport failure and stays unusable.
glossary.shared connection: The single gRPC client connection a `gateway.Provider` holds to its gateway, used by every sandbox it creates, with no connection watcher.

requirements.title: The gateway protocol
requirements.rationale: A second proto file with its own version keeps the Agent protocol and every agent build untouched while giving the gateway a typed, hash-checked wire contract.

criteria.action: declare in `sandbox/internal/sandboxpb/gateway.proto`, package `agentkit.sandbox.v1` with the same `go_package` as `sandbox.proto`, exactly one service `Gateway` with the six unary RPCs Capabilities, Create, SyncGit, List, Destroy and Reap, while `sandbox.proto` stays byte-unchanged and still declares exactly one service
criteria.contract: TS-13-1 passes unchanged; parsing gateway.proto finds one service with exactly those six non-streaming methods

criteria.action: define `SandboxSpec` mirroring `sandbox.Spec` field for field (Env and Labels as string maps, Resources with its four fields, a network-mode enum numbered none 0, allowlist 1, unrestricted 2, Allow as a list of host and port, TTL in nanoseconds, RequireLandlock as a bool, Provider as JSON bytes), carry every time as Unix nanoseconds with no well-known types, and define `Refusal{kind, field, reason, message}` with kinds UNSUPPORTED, NO_AGENT, NO_PUBLISHED_IMAGE, PROTOCOL, CAPACITY and REFUSED
criteria.contract: the generated Go types expose exactly these fields; gateway.proto imports no google/protobuf well-known type

criteria.action: for any `sandbox.Spec` whose Provider value encodes as JSON, and for any `sandbox.Capabilities`, convert to the wire message and back to a value equal to the original (Provider compared as decoded JSON)
criteria.contract: round trip yields reflect.DeepEqual values

criteria.action: export `ProtocolMajor = 1`, `ProtocolMinor = 0` and `SandboxIDKey = "agentkit-sandbox-id"`, and leave `sandbox.ProtocolMajor` and `sandbox.ProtocolMinor` (2) unchanged
criteria.contract: constants compare equal to 1, 0, "agentkit-sandbox-id" and sandbox.ProtocolMinor == 2

criteria.action: send `authorization: Bearer <token>` on every RPC of both services, send `agentkit-sandbox-id: <id>` on every Agent RPC, and never put a sandbox id in the metadata of a Gateway RPC (ids travel in the request message)
criteria.contract: a recording fake gateway sees the authorization key on every RPC, the id key on every Agent RPC and on no Gateway RPC

criteria.condition: `make proto` runs
criteria.action: generate `gateway.pb.go` and `gateway_grpc.pb.go` with the same pinned plugins and the same `(unknown)` header rewrite as the Agent files, record `gateway.proto.sha256`, and have the policy proto tests list the four new files
criteria.contract: internal/policy proto tests read and check gateway.proto, both generated files and the hash file

criteria.condition: the SHA-256 of `gateway.proto` differs from the value in `gateway.proto.sha256`
criteria.action: fail offline without invoking protoc
criteria.contract: the test fails with a message containing "run make proto"

requirements.title: Dialling a gateway
requirements.rationale: Capabilities() has no context or error, so the URL, the token and the gateway's identity must be checked once at Dial, and a bearer token must never cross a network in clear text.

criteria.condition: `Dial(ctx, rawURL, Options)` is called with `https://host[:port]`, or with `http://host[:port]` whose host is `localhost` or a loopback IP literal
criteria.action: connect with TLS and default port 443 for https, or plaintext and default port 80 for http, using `Options.Dialer` instead of TCP when it is set
criteria.contract: the dialer receives host:443 or host:80 when no port is given

criteria.condition: the URL carries user information, a query, a fragment, a path other than empty or `/`, a scheme other than http or https, or an http host that is neither `localhost` nor a loopback IP literal
criteria.action: refuse the URL without attempting a connection
criteria.contract: Dial returns a nil *Provider and an error naming the offending part; the Dialer is called 0 times

criteria.condition: `Options.Token` is empty or contains a character outside printable ASCII or any whitespace
criteria.action: refuse the token without attempting a connection
criteria.contract: Dial returns a nil *Provider and an error naming the token rule; the Dialer is called 0 times; the token value does not appear in the error text

criteria.action: for https use a clone of `Options.TLSConfig` or, when it is nil, the system roots with MinVersion TLS 1.2, default `ServerName` to the URL host, set send and receive limits to `sandbox.MaxMessageBytes`, and send the token as per-RPC credentials that require transport security for https
criteria.contract: the caller's TLSConfig is not mutated; a TLS test server with a certificate for the URL host accepts the Dial

criteria.condition: the gateway answers `Capabilities` under ctx with the same gateway protocol major
criteria.action: return a *Provider whose `Gateway()` reports the URL, the gateway version, the backend name, the gateway protocol major and minor, MaxTTL and MaxSandboxes from that answer
criteria.contract: Dial returns (*Provider, nil) and Gateway() equals the answered values

criteria.condition: `Capabilities` at Dial is answered `Unauthenticated`, for a missing or wrong token
criteria.action: close the connection and fail
criteria.contract: Dial returns an error for which errors.Is(err, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated) is true

criteria.condition: the gateway reports a gateway protocol major other than `gateway.ProtocolMajor`
criteria.action: close the connection and fail
criteria.contract: Dial returns an error wrapping sandbox.ErrProtocol whose text names both the gateway's and the client's versions

criteria.condition: `Capabilities` at Dial fails for any other reason, including ctx ending
criteria.action: close the connection and fail
criteria.contract: Dial returns an error whose text contains the URL

requirements.title: The gateway Provider's methods
requirements.rationale: The provider must look like any other sandbox.Provider while letting an embedder enumerate and destroy what it left on a shared gateway.

criteria.action: return from `Capabilities()`, without an RPC, the answer cached at Dial: Provider `"gateway/" + <backend provider>`, Network the offered modes within the gateway's ceiling, Isolation, Resources, Image, Workdir and Landlock as the backend's, and Notes as the backend's notes followed by one sentence naming the gateway host, its maximum TTL and its maximum number of sandboxes
criteria.contract: over a local backend with ceiling [NetworkUnrestricted], Provider is "gateway/local" and Network is [NetworkUnrestricted]

criteria.condition: `Reap(ctx)` is called
criteria.action: call `Gateway.Reap` and return the removed ids sorted ascending
criteria.contract: returns (sorted ids, nil) when the server's error text is empty, and (sorted ids, error containing the server's error text) otherwise

criteria.condition: `List(ctx)` is called
criteria.action: call `Gateway.List` and return the caller's sandboxes as `Info{ID, Labels, Created, Expires}` sorted by Created and then by ID
criteria.contract: []Info in that order

criteria.condition: `Destroy(ctx, id)` is called
criteria.action: call `Gateway.Destroy` for id, treating an unknown id as success so that repeated calls are idempotent
criteria.contract: returns nil for a known id, for an unknown id and on a second call for the same id; the backend sandbox is gone afterwards

criteria.condition: `Provider.Close()` is called while sandboxes created through it are still open
criteria.action: close each of those sandboxes, which destroys each on the gateway, then close the shared connection; later calls to Close do nothing
criteria.contract: returns errors.Join of every failure (nil when none); a second Close returns nil; every backend local directory is gone

criteria.condition: `Create`, `Reap`, `List` or `Destroy` is called after `Provider.Close`
criteria.action: fail without sending an RPC
criteria.contract: the method returns an error matching gateway.ErrClosed; the fake gateway records 0 RPCs

criteria.condition: any Gateway RPC after Dial is answered `Unauthenticated`
criteria.action: return an authentication failure
criteria.contract: the error matches gateway.ErrUnauthenticated

requirements.title: Creating a sandbox through the gateway
requirements.rationale: Create must fail early with the same typed errors a local provider gives, and must never strand a sandbox the gateway already created.

criteria.condition: `Create(ctx, spec)` receives a spec that `sandbox.CheckSpec(p.Capabilities(), spec)` refuses, whose effective TTL exceeds the gateway's MaxTTL, or whose `Provider` value does not encode as JSON
criteria.action: refuse the spec before any RPC
criteria.contract: returns a *sandbox.SpecError matching sandbox.ErrUnsupported with Provider "gateway/<backend>" and Field the refused field (for example RequireLandlock, Image, Network.Mode, TTL or Provider); the fake gateway records 0 Create RPCs

criteria.condition: `Create` receives a spec with an empty `Image`
criteria.action: send the client's own `sandbox.DefaultImage()` as the image, and when DefaultImage fails return its error unchanged without sending Create
criteria.contract: the Create request carries DefaultImage()'s value; on failure the returned error matches sandbox.ErrNoPublishedImage and 0 Create RPCs are sent

criteria.condition: `Gateway.Create` or `Gateway.SyncGit` answers with a refusal, or fails with a gRPC error
criteria.action: map the refusal to the sentinel for its kind, carrying the server's message
criteria.contract: UNSUPPORTED with a field becomes *sandbox.SpecError{Provider: client provider name, Field, Reason}; UNSUPPORTED without a field wraps sandbox.ErrUnsupported; NO_AGENT wraps sandbox.ErrNoAgent; NO_PUBLISHED_IMAGE wraps sandbox.ErrNoPublishedImage; PROTOCOL wraps sandbox.ErrProtocol; CAPACITY wraps gateway.ErrCapacity; REFUSED is a plain error; a gRPC error becomes an error naming the gateway URL

criteria.condition: `Gateway.Create` returns an id and effective spec
criteria.action: call `attach.New` over the shared connection wrapped so it is not a *grpc.ClientConn, with a no-op closer and `Config{ID: id, Spec: effective spec, Metadata: {agentkit-sandbox-id: id}, Provider: client provider name, Destroy: Gateway.Destroy(id)}`, and return its sandbox
criteria.contract: the returned sandbox's ID() is the gateway id, Spec() is the effective spec with Workdir as the agent reported it, Agent() is the relayed Hello; Tools, Export, Sync of Tar or LocalDir and Close are attach's

criteria.condition: the attach handshake fails after `Gateway.Create` succeeded, or ctx ends after `Gateway.Create` succeeded but before `Create` returns
criteria.action: send `Gateway.Destroy` for the id (through attach's destroy step for a handshake failure, by the client itself for an ended ctx)
criteria.contract: Create returns a non-nil error and no sandbox; List no longer reports the id; the backend local directory is gone

criteria.condition: `Sync(ctx, sandbox.GitRepo{...})` is called on a gateway sandbox
criteria.action: check `attach.Live`, then run `gitclone.Check` (refusing an invalid repository before any RPC), then call `Gateway.SyncGit{id, URL, Ref, Depth}` under ctx, mapping a refusal as in 19-REQ-4.3
criteria.contract: success returns a zero SyncResult and nil; a closed or unavailable sandbox returns attach's ErrClosed or ErrUnavailable with 0 RPCs; an invalid repository returns gitclone.Check's error with 0 RPCs

criteria.condition: `Close` is called on a gateway sandbox
criteria.action: run attach's teardown, which sends `Gateway.Destroy` with attach's fresh 30-second context
criteria.contract: returns nil and the backend sandbox is gone; when Destroy fails, Close returns that error and the entry stays on the gateway until its expiry

requirements.title: Server configuration, authentication and ownership
requirements.rationale: The server is the trust boundary: every RPC is authenticated before anything else is read, and one token holder can neither reach nor discover another's sandboxes.

criteria.condition: `gatewayd.New(Config)` gets a nil Backend, no tokens, a token shorter than 32 characters or containing non-printable ASCII or whitespace, a repeated token, a negative MaxSandboxes, MaxTTL or ReapInterval, or NetworkModes whose intersection with the backend's modes is empty
criteria.action: refuse the configuration
criteria.contract: New returns a nil *Server and a non-nil error; for the network case the error names both the configured and the backend's mode lists

criteria.condition: `New` gets zero values for the optional fields
criteria.action: apply the defaults NetworkModes [NetworkNone], MaxSandboxes 16, MaxTTL 24h, ReapInterval 10m and a discarding Logger
criteria.contract: a client's Capabilities shows Network [NetworkNone] (when the backend offers it), MaxSandboxes 16 and MaxTTL 24h

criteria.condition: `Serve(listener)` is called
criteria.action: run a gRPC server with `sandbox.MaxMessageBytes` send and receive limits, TLS credentials when Config.TLS is set and plaintext otherwise, the Gateway service and the Agent relay registered, an authentication interceptor on every unary and streaming RPC, and `Backend.Reap` once at start and every ReapInterval with failures logged and never fatal
criteria.contract: Serve returns nil after Shutdown and the listener's error otherwise; a counting backend sees Reap at start

criteria.condition: an RPC of either service arrives without `authorization: Bearer <token>` matching a configured token under a constant-time comparison
criteria.action: reject it without reading the rest of the request or calling the backend, and log one line with the peer address
criteria.contract: status Unauthenticated; a counting backend records 0 Create calls; the log line contains the peer address and no token

criteria.action: keep only each token's SHA-256 as the owner identity of every sandbox it creates, and show only the first 8 hex characters of that hash in logs
criteria.contract: no log line contains a configured token; create log lines carry an 8-hex-character owner fingerprint

criteria.condition: a caller authenticated with token B names, in an Agent RPC, SyncGit, Destroy or List, a sandbox created with token A
criteria.action: answer exactly as for an id that does not exist and leave the sandbox untouched
criteria.contract: List with B omits it; Destroy with B answers OK and the sandbox stays live for A; an Agent RPC with B answers Unavailable naming the id; SyncGit with B answers as for an unknown id

criteria.action: log one structured line per create (id, owner fingerprint, TTL, network mode), per destroy (id and reason `client`, `expired`, `unavailable` or `shutdown`), per refused authentication (peer address) and per backend reap, and never log a token, an Env value, a tool input or a tool result
criteria.contract: a captured slog handler sees those attributes; a test with a secret token, Env value and tool payload finds none of them in the captured output

criteria.condition: `List` or `Reap` is called by an authenticated caller
criteria.action: answer List with the caller's entries (id, labels, creation and expiry time) and answer Reap by running `Backend.Reap`
criteria.contract: ReapResponse carries the removed ids and the joined error text, empty when every removal succeeded

requirements.title: Server sandbox lifecycle
requirements.rationale: A network service must bound what any token holder consumes and must never leave a backend sandbox behind.

criteria.condition: a Create request is malformed, carries an unknown enum value, or carries Provider JSON that `wire.Guard` rejects under the default limits
criteria.action: reject it without calling the backend
criteria.contract: status InvalidArgument; the backend's Create count is unchanged

criteria.condition: a Create request asks for a network mode outside the network ceiling, or a TTL above MaxTTL
criteria.action: refuse it without calling the backend, counting a zero TTL as 1h
criteria.contract: Refusal UNSUPPORTED with field Network.Mode or TTL respectively

criteria.condition: after pruning entries whose backend sandbox is no longer live, recorded sandboxes plus creates already in progress reach MaxSandboxes, including under concurrent Create calls
criteria.action: refuse the Create without calling the backend
criteria.contract: Refusal CAPACITY (client error matches gateway.ErrCapacity); with MaxSandboxes N and N+k concurrent Creates exactly N succeed

criteria.condition: `Backend.Create(rpcCtx, spec)` returns an error
criteria.action: map the error to a refusal or a status
criteria.contract: *sandbox.SpecError becomes UNSUPPORTED with its field and reason; another ErrUnsupported becomes UNSUPPORTED; ErrNoAgent becomes NO_AGENT; ErrNoPublishedImage becomes NO_PUBLISHED_IMAGE; ErrProtocol becomes PROTOCOL; anything else becomes status Unavailable carrying its message

criteria.condition: the backend sandbox exposes no agent connection through attach's accessor, or the RPC context is done by the time `Backend.Create` returns
criteria.action: close the backend sandbox and record nothing
criteria.contract: status Internal naming the backend for the unrelayable case; no entry is recorded and the backend sandbox is gone in both cases

criteria.condition: `Backend.Create` returns a relayable sandbox to a caller still waiting
criteria.action: record an entry with the owner, the creation time, expires = created + effective TTL and the effective spec, and answer with the backend sandbox's ID() and Spec(), the creation time and the expiry
criteria.contract: CreateResponse{id = backend ID(), effective spec, created, expires}

criteria.condition: an entry reaches its expiry, any access finds its backend sandbox no longer live, or its owner calls Destroy
criteria.action: remove the entry and close its backend sandbox, treating Destroy of an unknown id as a no-op
criteria.contract: Destroy answers OK for a known or unknown id; when the backend's Close fails the entry is removed anyway and Destroy answers Unavailable carrying the error; after a 2-second TTL the backend local directory is gone

criteria.condition: `Shutdown(ctx)` is called
criteria.action: stop accepting new RPCs, close every backend sandbox it holds (ending relayed calls in flight), wait for handlers until ctx is done and then force the server to stop; later calls do nothing
criteria.contract: returns errors.Join of the close failures (nil when none); a second Shutdown returns nil; Serve returns nil; every backend sandbox is gone

requirements.title: The Agent relay and the GitRepo slot
requirements.rationale: attach decides liveness by status code, so the relay must keep the four refusal codes for the agent alone, strip private metadata, and keep spec 17's slot rules that relayed RPCs would otherwise bypass.

criteria.condition: an authenticated Hello, Tools, Call, SyncTar, ExportTar or Rsync arrives naming a live sandbox of the caller in `agentkit-sandbox-id`
criteria.action: forward it over the backend sandbox's own agent connection under the incoming RPC's context, with messages unchanged including unknown fields, copying streams frame by frame in both directions and propagating a half-close
criteria.contract: cancelling the host call cancels the agent call; a relayed message with an unknown field arrives with that field intact

criteria.condition: the `agentkit-sandbox-id` value is missing or malformed, is unknown, belongs to another owner, or names a sandbox whose backend is not live
criteria.action: answer without contacting any agent, and for a non-live backend also close the sandbox and remove its entry
criteria.contract: status Unavailable whose message names the id; never InvalidArgument, FailedPrecondition, NotFound or Unimplemented

criteria.action: forward none of the incoming metadata to the agent
criteria.contract: an agent recording incoming metadata on every RPC it serves never sees the authorization or agentkit-sandbox-id key

criteria.condition: the agent answers a relayed RPC with an error, or the RPC is an Agent method the gateway's build does not know
criteria.action: pass InvalidArgument, FailedPrecondition, NotFound and Unimplemented through with their messages and convert every other upstream error to Unavailable carrying the upstream message
criteria.contract: an Export of a missing path returns the agent's NotFound refusal and the client sandbox stays live; an unknown method answers Unimplemented

criteria.condition: `SyncGit` arrives for a sandbox whose GitRepo slot is taken by an earlier successful SyncGit, the first relayed Tools whatever its outcome, a relayed SyncTar that succeeded, or a relayed Rsync whose start frame says SYNC and that ended OK
criteria.action: refuse the SyncGit without calling the backend
criteria.contract: Refusal REFUSED with message "GitRepo must be the first Sync and come before Tools"

criteria.condition: `SyncGit` arrives for a caller's live sandbox whose slot is free
criteria.action: call `Sync(ctx, sandbox.GitRepo{URL, Ref, Depth})` on the backend sandbox and take the slot only when it succeeds
criteria.contract: success answers with no refusal; ErrUnsupported becomes UNSUPPORTED (client error matches sandbox.ErrUnsupported, as on a local backend); any other error becomes REFUSED carrying its message and leaves the slot free

criteria.action: for any interleaving of concurrent SyncGit and slot-taking relayed RPCs on one sandbox, serialise them so the outcome equals some sequential order of the same calls
criteria.contract: either SyncGit succeeds and precedes the Tools, or the Tools takes the slot and SyncGit is REFUSED; never both proceed

criteria.action: make `attach.ClientConn` and `attach.Live` follow a sandbox's `Unwrap() sandbox.Sandbox` chain, and give the `sandbox/podman` and `sandbox/landlock` wrapper types an unexported-type `Unwrap` method returning the attached sandbox, with no exported identifier of any package changed
criteria.contract: ClientConn of a wrapper returns the attached sandbox's connection; the exported-API golden is unchanged

requirements.title: The agentkit-gateway command
requirements.rationale: The one network service must be safe without flags: loopback by default, TLS or explicit plaintext, tokens only from a file, Podman or Docker only.

criteria.condition: `agentkit-gateway` starts with a valid `--token-file` and either `--plaintext` or both `--tls-cert` and `--tls-key`
criteria.action: build the backend with `podman.New(podman.Options{Binary, Engine, Runtime, UserNS, EngineEnv: the command's environment})`, bind `--listen` (default 127.0.0.1:8443) and print one stderr line `agentkit-gateway: listening on <bound address> (<tls|plaintext>), backend <name>, version <v>`
criteria.contract: with a fake engine script printing `podman version 5.0.0` on PATH, the line appears and a client Dial succeeds with Capabilities().Provider == "gateway/podman"

criteria.condition: `--plaintext` is used with a non-loopback listen address
criteria.action: log one warning line on stderr in addition to the listening line
criteria.contract: stderr contains a warning naming plaintext and the address

criteria.condition: the token file is read
criteria.action: take one token per line, ignore blank lines and lines starting with `#`, trim surrounding whitespace, apply the token rules of 19-REQ-5.1, and accept tokens from no flag or environment variable
criteria.contract: a file with comments, blank lines and padded tokens yields exactly the padded tokens trimmed

criteria.condition: the running command receives SIGINT or SIGTERM
criteria.action: run `Shutdown` with a 60-second budget
criteria.contract: exit code 0, or 1 when destroying any sandbox failed

criteria.condition: the arguments contain an unknown flag, no `--token-file`, only one of the TLS pair, `--plaintext` together with TLS flags, neither plaintext nor TLS, an `--engine` other than empty, podman or docker, a `--runtime` other than empty or krun, a `--network` entry other than none or unrestricted, a non-positive `--max-sandboxes`, `--max-ttl` or `--reap-interval`, or an extra positional argument
criteria.action: exit before reading the token file or contacting the engine
criteria.contract: exit code 2 and exactly one stderr line `agentkit-gateway: <cause>`

criteria.condition: the token file cannot be read or holds an invalid token, the TLS files are invalid, `podman.New` fails, or listening fails
criteria.action: exit without serving
criteria.contract: exit code 1 and exactly one stderr line `agentkit-gateway: <cause>`; no token value appears in it

criteria.condition: `--version` is given
criteria.action: print `agentkit-gateway <version> (gateway protocol M.N, agent protocol M.N)` with `buildver.Version()` as the version
criteria.contract: exit code 0; the protocol numbers equal gateway.ProtocolMajor.Minor and sandbox.ProtocolMajor.Minor

requirements.title: Module, build and policy wiring
requirements.rationale: The library's promise to listen on no socket and its dependency budget stay checked invariants, and the new module is held to the same gates as the others.

criteria.action: be a separate module at `sandbox/gatewayd` with `go 1.27`, `replace ../../` for the root and `replace ../` for the sandbox module, and direct requirements limited to the root module, the sandbox module, gRPC and (only when imported directly) protobuf
criteria.contract: a policy test checks the direct set is on the allowlist and within that set; `sandboxModules` lists the gatewayd module path

criteria.action: resolve a `go list -m all` graph that contains no module absent from the sandbox module's graph
criteria.contract: a policy test comparing the two graphs passes

criteria.action: include `sandbox/gatewayd` in `gateModules`, building and vetting it on all four targets with cgo off and on the host with cgo on
criteria.contract: the cross-target gate test covers sandbox/gatewayd

criteria.condition: a non-test Go file of the root or sandbox module refers to `net.Listen`, `net.ListenTCP`, `net.ListenUnix`, `net.ListenPacket`, `net.ListenConfig`, `tls.Listen` or `http.ListenAndServe*`
criteria.action: fail the no-listen check, which exempts only the gatewayd module
criteria.contract: the test fails naming the file and the API; it passes on the tree as delivered

criteria.action: leave the root and sandbox modules' direct requirements and graphs, the exported-API golden for agentkit, core, tools and codemode, and `sandbox.ProtocolMinor` unchanged
criteria.contract: the existing graph, golden and version policy tests pass with unchanged testdata

criteria.condition: `make sandbox-gateway` runs
criteria.action: build `build/bin/agentkit-gateway` with `-trimpath`, adding `-ldflags -X …/sandbox/internal/buildver.stamp=$(AGENTKIT_VERSION)` when AGENTKIT_VERSION is set; `MODULES` and the doc loop include sandbox/gatewayd, and `make sandbox-gateway-test` depends on sandbox-images and is not part of `make check`
criteria.contract: a built binary's --version reports the stamped version

criteria.action: run `make check`, including every gatewayd test, without network access, a container engine or protoc
criteria.contract: opt-in engine tests skip and every offline test passes with no engine on PATH and no network

requirements.title: Parity with a local sandbox
requirements.rationale: To the embedder and the model a gateway sandbox must behave exactly like a local one, including how it fails.

criteria.action: for any proxy tool returned by `Tools` of a sandbox created through an in-process gateway over `local`, report Name, Description, PromptGuidelines, Builtin, ExecutionMode and Label equal to the matching `tools.All` tool with both schemas marshalling to byte-identical JSON, and pass the shared `internal/toolconformance` table
criteria.contract: field-by-field equality and the conformance table pass unchanged from spec 13

criteria.condition: a proxy tool call through the gateway is cancelled from the host
criteria.action: end the call and the process it started
criteria.contract: the call returns outcome aborted and the started process no longer exists

criteria.action: for any generated tree, produce through a `LocalDir` Sync and Export and a `Tar` Sync and Export the same workspace and destination trees as a direct `local` sandbox
criteria.contract: tree comparisons with the direct run are equal

criteria.condition: the client-to-gateway connection is cut, the backend agent's connection is cut with `localtest.Cut`, or the gateway destroys the sandbox
criteria.action: fail the calls in flight and every later call on that sandbox
criteria.contract: each returns an error matching sandbox.ErrUnavailable (sandbox_unavailable)

criteria.condition: a container engine and AGENTKIT_SANDBOX_BASE_IMAGE are available and the tests do not run under -short
criteria.action: support Create under NetworkNone, a LocalDir Sync, proxy read_file, write_file and execute, Export, and a GitRepo Sync cloning a public repository after which TCP from execute still fails, and leave no container or volume with the sandbox label after Close and after Shutdown
criteria.contract: the opt-in tests pass; without an engine, without the image variable or under -short they skip

execution_paths.title: An embedder dials a gateway, creates a sandbox and runs a proxy tool

steps.action: calls gateway.Dial(ctx, "http://127.0.0.1", Options{Token, Dialer})
validates the URL and token and sends Gateway.Capabilities with authorization: Bearer <token>
authenticates the token, records its SHA-256 owner and answers capabilities named for the local backend within the network ceiling
